subject: general
question: Which of the following parts of the engine is used to compress the charge during the compression stroke and transmit the gas force to the connecting rod and then to the crankshaft during the power stroke?
solution:
The correct answer is __Piston__.

**__Key Points__**

__
 
• Piston__ is a crucial component of an engine.
 
• During the compression stroke, it is used to compress the charge.
 
• During the power stroke, it transmits the gas force to the connecting rod.
 
• It is connected to the crankshaft through the connecting rod for power transmission.
 
• The piston moves up and down in the cylinder to complete the engine's cycles.

**__Additional Information__**

 
• **Cylinder Head:**

 
 
• The cylinder head is located at the top of the cylinder block.
 
• It houses components like valves, spark plugs, and injectors.
 
 
 
• **Cylinder Block:**
 
 
• It forms the main structure of the engine.
 
• It holds cylinders, pistons, and crankshaft.
 
 
 
• **Crankcase:**
 
 
• It is the housing for the crankshaft and other engine components.
 
• It provides structural integrity to the engine.
